title: Apprentices under contract in France (end of month)
description: Number of apprentices with a current apprenticeship contract on the last day of each month in France, by employer sector and level of the diploma prepared.
source_label: DARES, POEM series new_cap_tot_stk, new_cap_prive_stk, new_cap_public_stk, new_cap_second_stk, new_cap_sup_stk
comparability: Stock: apprentices under contract on the last day of the month. DARES generally treats the last 48 months as provisional (flag 'p'). France, national source (DARES apprenticeship information system: Ari@ne and consular chambers 2013–2019, Deca from 2020, with DARES estimates for late reporting — using DSN for the most recent year). Covers ALL apprenticeship contracts, including the large and growing share preparing higher-education diplomas (Bac+2 to master/engineer, i.e. EQF 5–7), which most other countries' apprenticeship counts do not include. Geography: all French départements including the overseas DROM, excluding COM; employer establishment address. Raw data, not seasonally adjusted (strong September peak). The 'Scope' breakdown gives two alternative partitions of the total (by employer sector, and by level), so do not add sector and level values together. Do not sum with other countries.
